new_value: Root-signed DODAG version authorization (option 0x16, Schnorr48 over LICHEN-RPL-DODAG-VERSION-v1 transcript) verified and propagated by non-root parents; lollipop floor rejects stale/replayed authorizations. Added negative tests (garbage sig, non-root key, mismatch, duplicate, truncated, stale version, idempotent replay) using canonical vectors from test/vectors/dodag_version_authorization.json; fixed dao_parents_for_source transit-group flush regression and runtime.rs Ipv6Addr compile break. cargo test -p lichen-rpl (233/233 lib + 54 integration) and lichen-node (266/267 lib, sole failure pre-existing secure.rs blockwise owned elsewhere) pass; clippy/fmt clean.
